target_contract.outcome_distribution: bust = 1 - established; star is a factual volume/production probability capped at established; role is the remainder
target_contract.representative_season: highest-volume post-cohort MLB season; never selected by fantasy category

established_probability.description: Probability of any post-cohort MLB season with at least 300 PA

regular_probability.description: Probability of any post-cohort MLB season with at least 450 PA

star_probability.description: Probability of any post-cohort MLB season with at least 450 PA and .800 OPS

established_probability.description: Probability of any post-cohort MLB season with at least 50 IP

rotation_probability.description: Probability of any post-cohort MLB season with at least 120 IP

star_probability.description: Probability of any post-cohort MLB season with at least 120 IP and a 3.75 ERA or better
